# kion_category (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion Category by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_category" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the Category to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `payer_id` (Number)
